title: Rental Objects
subtitle: Manage venues, equipment, vehicles, and experiences
wizardDescription: Use the wizard to create or edit rental object
confirmDelete: Are you sure you want to delete {{name}}?
table.name: Name
mediaDescription: Upload images of the rental object. First image becomes primary image.
locationDescriptionRequired: Specify the address and location of the rental object. This is required for venues and courts.
locationDescriptionOptional: Specify the address and location of the rental object if relevant.
locationOptionalNote: Location is optional for this category, but recommended if the object has a fixed location.
capacityDescription: Specify the maximum capacity for the rental object
capacityInfoVenue: Specify the maximum number of people who can use the venue simultaneously
capacityInfoExperience: Specify the maximum number of participants per experience
inventoryDescription: Specify inventory and allocation strategy for the rental object
openingHoursDescription: Specify opening hours for each day of the week
openingHoursInfo: Opening hours are used to show when the object is available for booking. Note that closing time must be after opening time.
pickupDescription: Specify pickup and return information for equipment and vehicles
pickupInfo: Pickup and return information is shown to users when booking
requirementsDescription: Specify requirements for vehicle rental (license, age, deposit)
requirementsInfo: Requirements are clearly displayed during booking and must be accepted by user
packagesDescription: Create additional packages for experiences (e.g: lunch, guided tour, equipment)
packagesInfo: Packages let you offer additional options users can select during booking
scheduleDescription: Specify when the experience is available (fixed schedule or on demand)
scheduleInfo: Fixed schedule shows in calendar, on demand requires manual approval
bookingDescription: Specify pricing and booking conditions for the rental object
bookingInfo: Price and conditions are clearly displayed to users before they confirm booking
contentDescription: Add detailed description and frequently asked questions
contentInfo: Detailed content and FAQ help users make informed decisions
reviewInfo: Check all information carefully before publishing. You can always edit later.
assigned: Objects your organization has been assigned responsibility for.
noAssigned: No rental objects assigned to your organization yet.
